book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Lukila lwa kunkoma Yesu
Yesu pakayomolite kughalongela malagho agho ghoha, kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake,
“Mungumanya kukita mbole ya majubha mabhili yaabhegha Pasaka, naywo Mwana ywa Mundu katakilukwa ngati kabhangalilwe mulupingika.”
Ndo hilongohi bha andundame na aghohi bha bhandu bhakikwemukana mu nyumba ya utabhala ya Ndundame Nkulu, lihina lyake Kayafa.
Bhakighombana ngati bhankamule Yesu kwa lupwepo na kunkoma.
Peni bhakilongela, “Yikotoke kubhegha muchekwa, hela bhubho yaabwitukila bhulwa mubhandu.”
Yesu kangupopohelwa mahuta akwo Betania
Yesu pakabheghite ku Betania mulubhagha lwa Simoni ywakabheghite na maloha,
nndala yumu kakinhikila na kyupa kya libho lya alabasita, kiimemite mahuta gha kunungila munu ghaabheghite gha ngalabha ngulu, kakighapopoha mu mutwe ghwa Yesu pakabheghite kangulyegha hilyo.
Ahundwa bhake paabhonite agho bhakikalala, bhakilongela, “Kya niki tunguhobheha ghwa ngalabha ahi ngulu?
Mahuta agha ghangahemenganitwe kwa ngalabha ngulu na ligwala ayo bhangakamuhitwe makapukwa.”
Yesu kakighamanya mahwacho ghabhe, na kakiaghombela, “Kiyaha niki mungunng'aha nndala ayu? Ywombe kandendela nnando ghwa maha muno.
Bhandu kapukwa mmegha nabho manjubha ghoha, peni maabhegha ng'obhe na nenga manjubha ghoha.
Pakambopokihiti agha mahuta mu mmili ghwangu, ngati kummika kala kwa kukulilwa kwa nenga.
Ninguaghombela hoto, kwohele paghulandamihwa Nhalo ghwa Maha munnima ghwoha, nnando aghu ghwakautendite nndala ayu ghwaakambukwa, kwa ukulungwo ghwake.”
Yuda kanguyitikila kunkiluka Yesu
Mbole Yuda Isikalioti, yumoo ywa bhala kumi na abhili, kakighenda kwa hilongohi bha mandundame
na kakikonya, “Mambegha niki handa ndankamuha Yesu kwa mwenga?” Bhakinkamuha hipalamande salasini hya madini gha fesa.
Kutandila lisaa alyo Yuda kakipalaha ng'ebhu ya maha ya kunkiluka Yesu.
Yesu kangulyegha mulyo ghwa Pasaka papamu na ahundwa bhake
Linjubha lya ulongohi lya chekwa ya mangati ghanga amila, ahundwa bhake bhakinhikila Yesu na bhakinkonya, “Ghungupala tughutendekehele kwoki pakulyeghela Pasaka?”
Kakiyanga, “Nng'ende kwa nnume yumu akwo ku kitami, na mukanng'ombele, ‘Nhunda kalongela habhu, lisaa lyangu liheghelela, na mulubhagha lwako ndalyegha Pasaka papamu na ahundwa bhangu.’ ”
Ndo ahundwa bhake bhakitenda handa paaghombilitwe na Yesu, nabho bhakitendekeha Pasaka.
Payihikite makimuhi Yesu kakitama pakulyeghela papamu na bhala ahundwa kumi na abhili.
Na paabheghite bhangulyegha Yesu kakilongela, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela yumu ywenu katangiluka.”
Bhene bhakihyongoloka muno, bhakiyanda kukonya yomu mbole ya yungi, “Bhuli Bambo, ndo nenga?”
Yesu kakialongela, “Yula ywakachwikite lingate papamu na nenga mukipumbulu, ndo katangiluka.
Mwana ywa Mundu kangughenda handa payityekitwe mu Malembo. Peni kimmone yula ywakankiluka yaabhegha mbaha kwa ywombe kangakotokite kubhelekwa.”
Mbole, Yuda yula ywakankilukite Yesu kakilongela, “Bhuli nhunda, ndo nenga?” Yesu kakinnyanga, “Ghwenga ghulongela na kila kighukilongela ndo hoto.”
Mulyo ghwa Bambo
Pabhaabheghiti bhangulyegha, Yesu kakitola lingate kakilumetula, na kakinnumba Chapanga, kakiapegha ahundwa bhake pakalongela, “Ntole, nlyeghe, aghu ndo mmili ghwangu.”
Mbole, kakighutola nnobho, kakilumba, kakiapegha pakalongela, “Nnyweghele mabhoha nnobho aghu.
Aghu ndo mwahi ghwa nenga ghuubhoneha ninganilo lyangu ndo hoto, mwahi ghuuyitika kwakya kuabhuhila ulemwa bhandu atangalo.
Peni nunguaghombela, kutandila hinu ndanywegha kangi ng'obhe difwai ayi ya nsabibu, mbaka linjubha lila pambala kunywegha difwai ya hyono papamu na mwenga mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Tate ghwangu.”
Mbole, paayomolite kuyimba lwimbo, bhakibhuka kughenda ku kitumbi kya Miseituni.
Yesu kangulondola kukita Petili katankana
Basi, Yesu kakiaghombela, “Lelo pakilo bhoha maamutuka na maaneka, kiyaha yityekwa mu Malembo, ‘Ndantuta yunakuhakila, na lumati lwa mene lwapwilinganika.’
Peni mbole ya nenga kuhyuka ndabhalongolela kughenda ku Galilaya.”
Petili kakiyanga, “Hata handa bhoha bhatakuleka, nenga ndakuleka ng'obhe.”
Yesu kakinng'ombela Petili, “Kulyaghila nungukughombela, mupakilo ya lelo kukali na njogholo kubhika, ghwangana pandatu.”
Peni Petili kakilongela, “Hata handa nungunoghwa kuhwegha papamu na ghwenga, ndakuleka ndwee.” Na ahundwa bhangi bhoha bhakilongela ubhwabhu abhu.
Yesu kangunnyupa Chapanga ku kitogholo kya Gatisemani
Mbole Yesu kakighenda papamu na ahundwa bhake mbaka ku kitogholo kiikemitwe Getisemane, ndo kakiaghombela, “Ntami apa nenga nungughenda pala kuyupa.”
Kakintola Petili papamu na bhala bhana abhili bha Sebedayu, naywo kakiyanda kuhyongoloka na kubhaghaya.
Mbole kakiaghombela, “Megha na kuhyongoloka mumwoyo hata ugheghela na kuhwegha. Ntame apa papamu na nenga nkotoke kughonja.”

Kakighenda kutali kya mandina, kakighwegha makukama pakayupa, kakilongela, “Tate ywangu, handa yaahotoleka, nnobho aghu ghumbitile kutali, hangi yikotoke kubhegha handa mumbala nenga peni yibheghe handa paghupala ghwenga.”
Kakiaghendela bhala ahundwa bhake na kakiabhona aghonja kala. Kakinkonya Petili, “Yibhegha bhuli mwenga andatu nnepelwa kutama meho na nenga hata lisaa limo?
Nkotoke kughonja, ngati nnyupe nkotoke kuyingila mu mayigho. Kulyaghila nhuki ghubhegha kala, peni mmili ndo nnyoyoho.”
Yesu kakialeka kangi na kughenda kuyupa kya ubhili kuyupa, “Tate ywangu, handa yinguhotoleka ng'obhe kimbamanda aki kikulu kikotoke kumbitila, hino, ghutende mughupala.”
Pakabhuyite kangi, kakiakolela aghonja, kiyaha bhakitopelwa na ng'ono.
Habhu kakialeka, kakighenda kangi kuyupa kya undatu paakilongela malagho ghaghala ghala.
Mbole, kakiabhuyila bhala ahundwa na kakiaghombela, “Nkali mungughonja na kupumulila? Nnole, lisaa lihika na Mwana ywa Mundu kangukamuhwa mu mabhoko gha bhandu bhanaulemwa.
Nnyinuke, tughende. Nnole yula ywakangiluka kanguheghelela.”
Yesu kangukamulwa

Yesu pakabheghitie kakali kangulongela, Yuda, yumu ywa bhala ahundwa kumi na abhili, kakihika pakalongohana na lumati lukulu lwa bhandu bhaabheghite na makechelo na hinduku bhaalaghilitwe na hilongohi bha andundame na hilongohi bha Akaayahudi.
Basi, aywo ywakapala kunkiluka kakiapegha kala naho kukita, “Mwene yumbala kumjambuha kwa kunkumbatila ndo munkamule.”
Kamu, Yuda kakinhikila Yesu na kumjambuha, “Mwika Nhunda.” Mbole kakinkumbatila.
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghanja, ghutende kila kighukihikilite.” Mbole bhala bhandu bhakinng'endela na bhakinkamula Yesu na kummopa.
Kamu, yumu ywa bhala bhaabheghite na Yesu pakabhonite agho, kakihomola kihimbi lwake, na kakintuta mmandwa ywa Ndundame Nkulu, na kunkechula lichikilo.
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghubhuyihe kihimbi muhala yake, kiyaha bhoha bhanakukoma kwa kihimbi bhaakomwa kwa kihimbi.
Bhuli, nungupala mmanye kukita ningahotolite kunnyupa Tate ywangu, naywo kanganyeghelite kyanalumu ya himati kumi na hibhili hya mahoka bhake bha kunane?
Peni, handa pandenda habhu, bhuli Malembo gha Chapanga ghangatwihilikite bhuli ghaalongela agha mbaka ghabwituke?”

Mu lisaa alyo Yesu kakilughombela lula lumati lwa bhandu, “Muhikila na makechelo na himbongambonga ngati mungamule nenga handa mpoka, manjubha matangalo nikitama ku Nyumba ya Chapanga panuahunda, kiyaha niki mukinngamula ng'obhe?
Peni agha ghoha ghabwitukila ngati Malembo ghaatyekitwe na ambuye ghatwihilike.” Ndo ahundwa bhake bhoha bhakibhutuka na bhakinneka.
Yesu mu ulongolo ghwa libalasa
Bhala bhaankamulite Yesu bhakinnyegha kwa Kayafa ywakabheghite Ndundame Nkulu. Na akwo bhakibhegha ahunda bha malaghilo na hilongohi bha Ayahudi.
Petili kakintughila kya kutali mbaka ku lubhigho lwa nyumba ya Ndundame Nkulu. Kakiyingila mulubhigho lwa nyumba na kakitama papamu na machonda ngati kabhone kiipala kubwituka.
Basi, hilongohi bha Ayahudi, na andundame na libalasa lyoha likipalaha ayimiho bha uhwangi, ngati bhankome Yesu.
Peni bhakimokola ng'obhe nnando ghwohele, hata payibhele ayimiho atangalo ahwangi bhakibwituka. Kuuhiko bhakibwituka ayimiho abhili bha uhwangi,
bhakilongela, “Mundu ayu kakilongela, ‘Ninguhotola kuyiboghoyola Nyumba ya Chapanga na kuyichenga kangi mu majubha mandatu.’ ”
Mbole, Ndundame Nkulu kakiyima na kunng'ombela Yesu, “Bhuli ghwenga ghubhegha ng'obhe na kyakuyanga? Bhandu abha anguyimiha niki kwa ghwenga?”
Peni Yesu kakinyamala jii. Ndo Ndundame Nkulu kakinng'ombela, “Ghulape muulongolo ghwa Chapanga yunaubhumi, ghutughombele handa ghwenga ndo Kilisto, Mwana ywa Chapanga.”
Yesu kakiyanga, “Ena, handa mughulongela. Peni nunguaghombela bhoha, kutandila hinu maamona Mwana ywa Mundu pakatama mbande ya nnilo ya Chapanga yunamakakala, pakahika mu mahundi gha kunane.”
Ndo Ndundame nkulu kakilakatula mapinda ghake pakalongela, “Ayu kangukundula! Kiyaha niki tungupala uyimiho ghungi kangi? Nnole, hinu mwenga nnyihwa agho makundulo.
Mwenga mungulamila bhuli nnando aghu?” Bhakinnyanga, “Kangunoghwa kuhwegha.”
Mbole bhakinhunila mata ku kibhungi na bhangi bhakinbhakula mabhako,
ghwenga Kilisto, “Ghulondole, ndo ghani ywakakubhakulite?”
Petili kangunkana Bambo Yesu
Lisaa alyo Petili kakitama mulubhigho. Nndumindumi yumu nndala ywa Ndundame Nkulu kakinhikila na kakinng'ombela, “Na ghwenga ghukibhegha papamu na Yesu ywa ku Galilaya.”
Peni Petili kakikana muulongolo ghwa bhoha pakalongela, “Ningumanya ng'obhe kighukilongela.”
Pakabheghite kangubhuka panje kuhika panlyango, nndumindumi yungi nndala kakimmona, na kakiaghombela bhandu bhaabheghite pala, “Mundu ayu kakibhegha papamu na Yesu ywa ku Nasaleti.”
Petili kakikana kangi kwa kilapo pakalongela, “Nenga nungummanya ng'obhe mundu aywo.”
Mbole kya mandina bhala bhaayimite pala bhakinng'endela Petili na bhakinng'ombela, “Kulyaghila ghwenga ndo yumu ywabhe, kiyaha kuyobhela kwa ghwenga kungulihwana na bhombe.”
Ndo Petili kakiyanda kulikundula na kulapa, “Nenga nungummanya ng'obhe mundu aywo.” Kamu mbichi kakibhika.
Petili kakihwachila lila lilagho lyakalongilite Yesu, “Kukali na kubhika njogholo, ghwangiluka pandatu.” Kakibhuka panje pakalila kwa kuchwina.
